name: qkd_land_pc-ks1-0b660bb49
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 (track B) KV landing strip leaf qkd_land_pc (32 a strip): the PC's CDC landing queue (credit landing, LCRED 6) and its credit port to the group leaf; the PC's embedding static port (es / er to qkd_ctrl_pc), 8-beat return FIFO and one station of the strip's down / up / credit / fault chains.  ~5.6k sinks, every port a flop at the pin.
